subject: Satellite VPC staging — phased provisioning, term alignment & cost bridge
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@solacethera.com>
Cc: 
Date: 2028-04-03T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Satellite VPC staging — initial scope and attachments

Hi Emily,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Per our conversation, I9m sharing a lightweight draft SOW and a suggested topology for the satellite VPCs you9re planning to add at renewal. The ask you raised was: 1) split the new environments across two regions, 2) stagger the cluster rollout (phase A / phase B), and 3) align the term so the additional capacity comes under a single enterprise contract.

Attachments: SOW_Solace-VPC-2028-draft.pdf (draft SOW), Topology_Satellite-Cluster.png

High-level asks from our side:
- Firm target dates for phase A (staging + analytics) & phase B (inference clusters)
- Expected QPS / concurrency for the satellite clusters (so we size capacity and recommend batching/quantization)
- Any data residency constraints beyond region split (e.g., air-gapped sites)

I9ve tentatively penciled Q3 rollout for phase A and Q4 for phase B to match your expected usage spike post-integration. Monica (CC9d) will follow up with a pricing sketch that shows both a one-time provisioning fee and the ongoing reserved capacity pricing.

If it helps, we can run a quick 30-min call with Jason Park (our partner for hands-on migration) to validate the network topologies next week.

Best,

Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Attachments: SOW_Solace-VPC-2028-draft.pdf, Topology_Satellite-Cluster.png
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@solacethera.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@solacethera.com>
Date: 2028-04-03T10:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Satellite VPC staging — initial scope and attachments

Thanks Lauren — received and reviewed quickly. A few clarifying items from our side:

- Cost breakdown: can you separate the one-time provisioning (infrastructure & migration) from the recurring reserved capacity line items? We want to show this to finance as two buckets.
- Phasing: Q3 / Q4 sounds reasonable, but we9ll need to confirm exact calendar weeks. Can the provisioning be split across calendar months (i.e., partial deployment in Sep, remaining in Oct)?
- Term: our procurement team is pushing for a single 24-month amendment that covers the new clusters rather than a short-term addendum. Does Redwood offer any renewal credit for multi-year commitments?
- Compliance: can you include SOC 2 Type II evidence and the audit log retention policy for private deployments? We9ll send a more formal questionnaire to you shortly.

Cc9d procurement so they9re looped. If you can get a cost sketch and an answer on multi-year credits by EOD tomorrow, we9ll try to lock calendar availability for the architecture review.

Best,
Emily
Head of Platform Engineering
Solace Therapeutics
emily.zhang@solacethera.com
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2028-04-03T11:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Satellite VPC staging — internal pricing notes (do not externalize)

Lauren / team,

Internal notes and proposed numbers before we send Emily a public-facing sheet:

- Provisioning (one-time): $48,000 — includes network setup, cluster seeding, partner migration support (Jason).
- Reserved capacity (per month): Phase A: 6 vGPU nodes @ $22k/mo equivalent list = $132,000/mo; Phase B: additional 8 vGPU nodes @ $22k/mo = $176,000/mo.
- Volume discount: 12% if they commit to 24 months across both phases; 6% for 12 months.
- Renewal credit ask: We can offer a 10% on recurring line items as a renewal/expansion credit if they commit to 24 months and include both satellite clusters in the amendment (DEAL-8421 term condition). This mirrors previous enterprise concessions but keeps the provisioning fee at list.
- Compliance artifacts: Dev, can you attach SOC2 Type II summary + retention policy? Also confirm how quickly we can provide exportable audit logs for private installs (target: within 48 hours).

Action owners:
- Karthik: review discount stance and confirm margin impact by 5pm today.
- Dev: SOC2 summary and audit log export timing.
- Lauren: send external-facing cost worksheet and SOW + call invite to Emily.

Thanks,
Monica
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai

From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@solacethera.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Jason Park <jason@cloudops-consulting.com>
Date: 2028-04-04T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: phased rollout schedule and pricing (Q3/Q4) — Solace Therapeutics (DEAL-8421)

Hi Emily,

Following Lauren9s note, attached is a cleaned-up cost worksheet and a phased rollout schedule we9re proposing. Highlights:

Phase A (staging + analytics) — target: 2028-09-15 to 2028-09-29
- One-time provisioning: $48,000
- Reserved capacity: 6 nodes (mixed inference/analytics) — $132,000/month

Phase B (inference clusters) — target: 2028-10-20 to 2028-11-03
- Reserved capacity: 8 nodes — $176,000/month

Term proposal:
- Option A: 12-month addendum for new clusters (standard renewal pricing).
- Option B: 24-month amendment covering both phases — we can offer a 10% recurring credit on the reserved capacity lines if you sign Option B before 2028-04-20.

Compliance and evidence: Dev attached a SOC 2 Type II summary and our audit log export process notes. Jason (cc9d) can run a quick topology validation during the architecture call.

Attachments: Solace_Proposal_Q3Q4.xlsx, SOC2_Summary_Solace.pdf, Topology_Satellite-Cluster.png

Next steps:
1) Confirm Option A vs Option B by 2028-04-20 to lock the pricing window.
2) If Option B is selected, we will generate an amendment and send DocuSign within 48 hours of confirmation.
3) Schedule 45-min architecture review with Jason & Dev (proposed times: 2028-04-10 09:00 PT or 2028-04-11 14:00 PT).

Happy to walk through the worksheet on a call.

Best,
Monica Patel
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.ai
Attachments: Solace_Proposal_Q3Q4.xlsx, SOC2_Summary_Solace.pdf, Topology_Satellite-Cluster.png
From: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@solacethera.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@solacethera.com>
Date: 2028-04-04T14:20:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: phased rollout schedule and pricing (Q3/Q4) — Solace Therapeutics (DEAL-8421)

Monica / Lauren,

Appreciate the clear breakdown. A few points from procurement / finance:

- We like Option B (24 months) but can only commit if Redwood will provide a 10% credit on recurring reserved capacity AND a one-time onboarding credit of $12,000 applied to phase A provisioning, given our internal budget cycle constraints.
- Can you confirm the change-control process for adding extra nodes mid-term? We may need burst capacity during November.
- SOC2 summary looks good at a glance; procurement will send a short questionnaire (security@solacethera.com). Please confirm you can turn around answers within 3 business days.

If you can confirm the 10% + $12k onboarding credit, we will route paperwork this week and target signature by 2028-04-18. Also, please include a simple clause that ensures we get priority capacity for the first 30 days after each phase goes live.

Thanks,
Emily
Head of Platform Engineering
Solace Therapeutics
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Emily Zhang <emily.zhang@solacethera.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>, Jason Park <jason@cloudops-consulting.com>
Date: 2028-04-04T16:00:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: phased rollout schedule and pricing (Q3/Q4) — Solace Therapeutics (DEAL-8421)

Emily,

Thanks — good, actionable counter. We can agree to the commercial items with the following conditions:

1) 10% recurring credit on reserved capacity if Solace signs the 24-month amendment covering both phases by 2028-04-20 (applies to recurring line items only).
2) One-time onboarding credit of $10,000 (we can stretch to $12,000 if Solace signs and commits to a small professional services minimum with Jason; he can confirm schedule/level-of-effort).
3) Priority capacity: we can add a 30-day priority buffer for each phase; this will be documented as an operational SLA in the amendment (subject to capacity constraints and reasonable-use limits).
4) Change-control: adding nodes mid-term requires a 4-week lead for procurement + provisioning; we can offer a 10% expedited provisioning fee for sub-4-week requests to ensure capacity.

Next steps: Monica will issue an updated worksheet that reflects the two options (the 24-month credit + $10k onboarding credit vs the 12-month standard). If Solace confirms the 24-month path, we will generate the amendment (DocuSign) and loop in our legal and Jason for the migration SOW.

Lauren Bishop
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
lauren.bishop@redwood.ai
Attachments: Updated_Solace_Worksheet_v2.xlsx, DocuSign_Link_pending
